qa_pairs.question: What should be done after grinding off welding beads on the wheel house?
qa_pairs.answer: Lift the end plate slightly and remove scrap metal.

qa_pairs.question: What preparation is required on mating surfaces before spot welding?
qa_pairs.answer: Straighten and grind all mating surfaces, then coat mating surfaces required for spot welding with zinc dust paint.

qa_pairs.question: What should be done with the new wheel house outer section after grinding mating surfaces?
qa_pairs.answer: Grind mating surfaces on new wheel house outer section and coat mating surfaces required for spot welding with zinc dust paint.

qa_pairs.question: How should the new wheel house outer section be secured during installation?
qa_pairs.answer: Insert and clamp down new wheel house outer section, tack welding if necessary.

qa_pairs.question: What needs to be checked when mounting the side panel?
qa_pairs.answer: Check door gap and transition to the tail panel, correcting with wheel house if necessary.

qa_pairs.question: What type of welding should be used on the wheel house?
qa_pairs.answer: Spot weld wheel house. Prepare areas for plug spot welding, when they are not accessible for spot welding tongs.

qa_pairs.question: What image reference number shows the step for grinding off welding beads?
qa_pairs.answer: Image reference number 30 41 592 shows the step for grinding off welding beads.

qa_pairs.question: What image reference number shows the removal of scrap metal?
qa_pairs.answer: Image reference number 30 41 593 shows lifting the end plate slightly and removing scrap metal.

qa_pairs.question: What image reference number demonstrates the mounting of the side panel?
qa_pairs.answer: Image reference number 30 41 598 demonstrates mounting the side panel.

qa_pairs.question: What coating is specified for mating surfaces that will be spot welded?
qa_pairs.answer: Zinc dust paint is specified for coating mating surfaces required for spot welding.

qa_pairs.question: What alternative welding method is mentioned when spot welding tongs are not accessible?
qa_pairs.answer: Plug spot welding should be prepared for areas where spot welding tongs are not accessible.

qa_pairs.question: What should be done to all mating surfaces before applying zinc dust paint?
qa_pairs.answer: Straighten and grind all mating surfaces before coating them with zinc dust paint.
